achieved.claim: Online revenues grew by 56% and contributed over 6% of Westside revenues.
Standalone revenue from operations reached ₹ 4,724 Cr with ₹ 477 Cr EBIT.
Like-for-like growth for the fashion portfolio was in low single digits.
Opened 19 Westside stores and 44 Zudio stores during the quarter.
